note: Illustrative risk appetite for this small synthetic cohort. Appendix D of the GRAIMATTER green paper shows the file format. Its example minimum for min_samples_leaf was 5. The values below are stricter so the contrast is visible on a few hundred rows. A TRE would set these from its own experiments and agree them with the data controller.

KNeighborsClassifier.reason: Instance-based model: every training row is stored in the model and can be read back (TECH 11).

SVC.reason: A standard support-vector classifier stores a subset of training rows as support vectors. The green paper recommends a differentially private variant, aggregated data, or query controls instead (TECH 11).
